title.narrative: Protection and durable alternatives to modern slavery in DRC

description.narrative:
The project aims to scale up ongoing, joint efforts in Mwenga, SouthKivu, by Caritas Norway and Caritas Congo to combat modern slavery, through a threepronged approach in cooperation with a local partner; Croisade Humanitaire. Targeting authorities, the corporate sector and especially vulnerable population groups, the proposed project will:
(i) step up and reinforce the dialogue between civil society and, on the one hand, authorities at all levels (local, national and regional) and, on the other hand, private sector entities (locally and internationally), to reduce the scope and prevalence of destructive practices of modern slavery in the South Kivu province.
(ii) Protect, empower and build resilience of younger children who are victims of- or at risk of being forcibly recruited into the worst forms of child labour, as well as especially vulnerable women and adult girls suffering other types of modern slavery in and around the mines. Sustainable alternatives will be offered to a total of 1200 vulnerable individuals and 600 households.
